justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/FinderPattern.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/Pair.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/expanded/ExpandedPair.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/RSS14Reader.java, core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/expanded/RSSExpandedReader.java, and core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/expanded/RSSExpandedInternalTestCase.java. FinderPattern is a small immutable value object with only one external dependency (ResultPoint) and no broad outgoing coupling. Its incoming use is limited to four production classes in the RSS readers/model objects (Pair, ExpandedPair, RSS14Reader, RSSExpandedReader) plus one test class, which is not strong fan-in for a dependency hub.
